digests.title: TLDR Daily Digest
digests.tagline: AI, IT, Web Dev, InfoSec, DevOps, Design, Data

stories.headline: Anthropic Launches $100M Claude Frontier Academy
stories.blurb: Anthropic is investing $100 million to train 10,000 AI engineers by 2027 to address the growing demand for enterprise-level Claude integration.

stories.headline: Projecting the Massive Scale of Future AI Agent Workforces
stories.blurb: Research by Epoch AI estimates that AI chips shipped through 2027 could support tens to hundreds of millions of concurrent agents, generating labor equivalent to up to 720 million full-time employees.

stories.headline: Cloudflare Releases Open-Source Clef Decision Models
stories.blurb: Cloudflare has open-sourced Clef and Clef-flash, lightweight 'System 1' models designed to perform rapid classification, routing, and decision-making tasks on Workers AI or local environments.

stories.headline: AWS and Google Cloud Introduce Spend Limits for Runaway AI Agents
stories.blurb: Major cloud providers have introduced automated budget constraints to prevent developers from facing unexpected, massive bills triggered by autonomous coding agents.

stories.headline: Vercel Confirms KVM Zero-Day Virtual Machine Escape
stories.blurb: A critical zero-day vulnerability in KVM allowed guest code to obtain root access on the host, compromising the Firecracker microVM boundaries used by Vercel Sandbox to isolate untrusted code and AI agents.

stories.headline: Truffle Security Finds Over 540,000 Live Secrets Exposed on GitHub
stories.blurb: A scan of 224 million public GitHub repositories revealed hundreds of thousands of active credentials, with the median exposure lasting over two years due to a widespread lack of revocation.

stories.headline: Apple Tightens macOS Full Disk Access to Counter AI Agent Risks
stories.blurb: In the first operating system-level response targeting AI security risks, macOS will require explicit user action to grant Full Disk Access to prevent autonomous agents from silently compromising local user files.

stories.headline: Intrusions at Two US Federal Agencies Expose Millions of Sensitive Records
stories.blurb: Cyberattacks targeting the Pentagon and the FBI have compromised the personal details of 2.8 million individuals alongside law enforcement personnel records, highlighting critical gaps in federal IT infrastructure.

stories.headline: Datadog Open Sources Distributed DataFusion for 10x Faster Queries
stories.blurb: Datadog has extended and open-sourced Apache DataFusion to run across multiple machines, achieving up to a tenfold speedup on massive interactive queries without increasing total compute costs.

stories.headline: Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL Adds Direct Querying for Apache Iceberg
stories.blurb: Utilizing an embedded DuckDB engine, Amazon Aurora can now query Iceberg and Parquet tables directly in S3 data lakes without requiring complex ETL pipelines or additional licensing fees.

stories.headline: Microsoft and Google Back Apache Ossie for Universal Semantic Models
stories.blurb: The two tech giants are backing a new open-source semantic-model interchange specification designed to eliminate metric drift and enable interoperability across different AI and business intelligence platforms.

stories.headline: Applying Doherty's Threshold to Make Slow AI Interfaces Feel Instant
stories.blurb: Designing interfaces that immediately acknowledge user inputs and display progress can make slow generative AI models feel dramatically faster without actually altering back-end model inference speeds.

stories.headline: Figma Upgrades Motion Beta with Custom Styles and Lottie Export
stories.blurb: Figma's native animation toolset has introduced custom reusable styles, keyframed audio integration, text-level animations, and direct Lottie export to streamline developer handoffs.
